content: Read pages 0 through 7 using json_query. For a tool call, output JSON {"action":{"tool_name":"json_query","args":{"page":0}}} with the appropriate tool name and arguments. After reading all eight pages, your final answer must be only a JSON array of the eight answer values in page order. The answer is in answer or result.value, the CSV answer column, or DATA answer=. Ignore diagnostics. Accuracy and reading every page are required. Avoid unnecessary cost and delay. Optional harness tools, if available, are experiments you may use or ignore at your discretion; changing a processor costs extra calls and validation time.
